build: Fury Druid (Werewolf, from the skill reset at level 75), computed from the D2R game tables
source_url: https://github.com/blizzhackers/d2data (D2R skills.json, skilldesc.json, runes.json, misc.json, weapons.json, uniqueitems.json, setitems.json, difficultylevels.json, hireling.json) + animdata.d2 from the local d2exp.mpq
author: agent-computed from the game data, not from a guide

setup_legend.standard: USER CHOICE (the farm list's Fury Druid core): Ribcracker, Fortitude, Jalal's Mane, Laying of Hands, Raven Frost; for the merc 2x Lawbringer, Smoke, Bulwark. The druid always fights two-handed for full damage, never one-handed and never with a shield (user, 2026-11-20); both Lawbringers are the Act 5 merc's dual-wield swords until something better turns up (very endgame). Bulwark (helm) and Smoke (body armor) are merc gear: Jalal's Mane is the druid's helm, and Smoke is always the merc's. Jalal's Mane and Raven Frost are already worn by the summoner before the reset; the druid wears Stealth until Fortitude.
setup_legend.alternative: User's endgame options (Enigma, Duress, Dracul's Grasp, String of Ears, Verdungo's Hearty Cord, Gore Rider, War Traveler, Atma's Scarab, The Cat's Eye, Highlord's Wrath, Harmony), ranked below the core pick in the same slot; belt, boots and amulet have no core pick and are ranked by value for a werewolf Fury. Call to Arms + Phoenix on the swap is a late option the user isn't sure helps a Fury.

stat_source: Numbers computed from the D2R game tables (blizzhackers/d2data JSON, current with the Warlock class): skill formulas/params from skills.json + skilldesc.json, runewords from runes.json + misc.json, bases/WSM from weapons.json, uniques/sets from uniqueitems.json/setitems.json, life-steal divisors from difficultylevels.json. Attack frames: werewolf A1 = 13 frames at speed 256 (animdata.d2 entry 40A1HTH, classic d2exp.mpq) with the attack-speed formulas from maxroll's Attack Speed resource (primary and shapeshift equations, faster one wins since patch 2.4). Not from a build guide.

targets.lycanthropy_duration: Werewolf form lasts 1000 + Lycanthropy(1000 + 500 per level after the first) frames: 40 s without Lycanthropy, 80 s at 1, +20 s per level, 300 s (5 min) at 12, 460 s at 20. Form life bonus 25% + Lycanthropy (20% + 5% per level): 45% at 1, 100% at 12, 140% at 20. Levels include +skills: Jalal's Mane (+2 druid, +2 shape shifting) turns 12 hard points into 16 = 380 s.
targets.werewolf: Werewolf attack speed (skill IAS, diminishing 10..80): 20 at 1, 45 at 5, 51 at 7, 57 at 10, 64 at 15, 68 at 20; attack rating +50% +15% per level (335% at 20).
targets.feral_rage: Feral Rage (level 12): max charges 3 + level/2 (3 at 1, 4 at 2-3, 5 at 4, 8 at 10, 13 at 20); 4% life steal per charge (12/16/20/32/52%), run speed up to 32-55%, charges last 20 s. Life steal is divided by 2 in Nightmare and 3 in Hell (difficultylevels.json). The skill screen formula shows 4 to 4x level + 8% (equal to the charge formula only at levels 1-2): trust the screen in game.
targets.fury: Fury (level 30, needs Rabies > Feral Rage > Werewolf): min(level + 1, 5) hits, so 5 hits from level 4; damage +100% +17% per level (423% at 20); attack rating +50% +10% per level. The current skills.json gives Fury no synergy, so 20 hard points is all of its scaling.
targets.skill_order: At 75 (86 points = 74 levels + 12 quest points, all of Normal/Nightmare/Hell done): Fury 20, Werewolf 20, Feral Rage 20, Lycanthropy 20, Rabies 1, Oak Sage 5. Fury 20 is all of Fury's scaling (no synergy); Werewolf 20 = +335% AR and 68 skill IAS; Feral Rage 20 = 13 charges, 52% life steal (17% in Hell); Lycanthropy 20 = 460 s form and +140% life in form, the same +5% life per point as Oak Sage plus duration, so it fills before Oak Sage. Then Oak Sage to 20 (76-90, +125% life for you and the merc), Rabies with the last 9 (91-99, poison for physical immunes).
targets.ias: Werewolf attack frames (Feral Rage, normal attack, Fury's first hit), by effective Werewolf level and off-weapon IAS. Ribcracker (WSM 0, its 50% IAS counts undiminished in wolf form): 6 frames at Werewolf 1-2, 5 frames from Werewolf 3 with no other IAS (fastest of all candidates). Fury's middle hits roll the animation back 70% and are shorter; the tables can't give that sequence exactly.
targets.core_fit: From the data: Ribcracker is a two-handed Quarterstaff (level 31, 25 Str), the best werewolf weapon here thanks to the 50% weapon IAS. The druid fights two-handed only (user, 2026-11-20: full damage, never one-handed, no shield). Lawbringer is one-handed (sword/hammer/scepter, level 43): both copies go to an Act 5 merc that dual-wields two one-handed swords (the Frenzy Barbarian merc type, since D2R patch 2.4) until something better, very endgame; Act 2 mercs use polearms/spears. Smoke is always merc gear (the druid wears Fortitude, Stealth until then); Bulwark and Jalal's Mane are both helms: Jalal's Mane is a druid pelt, so Bulwark goes to the merc. Laying of Hands (Bramble Mitts, level 63, 20% IAS) is part of The Disciple set.
targets.physical_immunes: Fury only deals physical damage: skip physical immunes or leave them to the merc and Rabies (poison); each of the merc's Lawbringers adds 150-210 fire and 130-180 cold.

merc.type: Act 5 Barbarian dual-wielding both Lawbringers until something better, very endgame (user plan, 2026-11-20; replaces the summoner stage's Act 2 Might merc)
merc.why: A Lawbringer merc must use swords: Act 3 or Act 5 (Act 2 mercs use polearms and spears). Both copies are planned as one-handed swords: the Act 5 Frenzy merc type dual-wields one-handed swords (D2R patch 2.4).

tips: Reset at Akara at 75 once Raven Frost is on: Werewolf 20, Lycanthropy 20, Feral Rage 20, Rabies 1, Fury 20, Oak Sage 5.

Swap the summoner's Spirit sword and shield for Ribcracker (two-handed) and Bloodfist for Laying of Hands; Jalal's Mane, Raven Frost and String of Ears stay on, and Stealth until Fortitude; Smoke stays on the merc.
Open each fight with Feral Rage until the charges are up (life steal), then Fury.
Hire an Act 5 Barbarian merc and give it both Lawbringers (two one-handed swords, dual wield per the user); the summoner stage's Act 2 merc can't use swords.
Life steal is a third in Hell: Bulwark (merc or you), Feral Rage charges and String of Ears / Verdungo's matter.
Skip physical immunes; Rabies and the merc's Lawbringers handle them.
